reviews.text:
I could not be happier with the care, kindness and attention my little one received from Dr Charlotte and receptionist Meghan.
Thank you so much for your care 🙏🏽 …
Hi, Maria. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

These vets were amazing. They helped us with an outdoor cat that  was quite difficult to keep calm.  They were very flexible with appointment timings and were genuinely concerned and very helpful.  Once we got to the vets they saw us immediately even though we were 30 min early.  During the examination our cat was treated very gently and kindly and Alice explained everything very clearly and made our cat feel comfortable. Megan at reception was very accommodating and genuinely was concerned for our cat and really helped accommodate us with flexibility.  I would thoroughly recommend these vets. I wish I'd found them sooner!
Verry Good Vet Surgery...:)

The doctors and nurses at the clinic were outstanding and took great care of my cat when I took him in for some dental work. They gave me plenty of reassurance ahead of the procedure, kept me informed throughout the day and explained very clearly how to help his recovery at home. It’s been less than 24 hours and he’s already back to his normal self. Really grateful for their excellent care, empathy and patience.
Amazing vets! The best in the area by far!
Fantastic team - all the staff is extremely friendly and the vet patiently answers all your questions and takes your concerns seriously. Highly recommend!

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic, my cat is usually very scared of vet visits, but everyone were so gentle, patient, and kind with her. The staff were professional, caring, and explained everything clearly. Thank you so much for taking such great care of my cat Pulya. Highly recommend Tooting Veterinary!

We always have a really good experience. Reception staff warm, friendly & efficient and VETS amazing - super knowledgeable, reassuring, patient with our Boy, never feel rushed & always feel we are in expert hands. Thank you for your FIVE STAR care!
Great practice. Alice and the team are always great with my dog.

We have always had amazing support from these vets. We have been with this company for over 10 years and have visited their Streatham, Wimbledon and now Tooting practices. They are all great. I went to the Tooting practice for the first time yesterday. A really calm, professional environment and our vet, Amelia, was amazing. She was knowledgable and reassuring. We have seen her before at another practice and she recognised us and was so kind and gentle with my cat. I absolutely recommend them.
The whole team at Tooting Vet are exceptional in the service, support and genuine care they consistently give. Highly recommend them.

Amelia and the receptionist that greeted us were friendly and answered all our queries related to the VIP plan 😊 we felt welcomed and our kittens were well looked after. Thank you Amelia and team for your friendly approach today. It didn’t go unnoticed! …

We honestly cannot thank the whole team enough for everything they’ve done for Tonino throughout his diagnosis, surgery and recovery.

From the moment you walk through the door (even on the phone!) every single person at reception is kind, welcoming, patient and genuinely supportive - especially during stressful moments when your pet is unwell. You can tell this is a team that truly cares, not just about the animals, but also about the people attached to them.

A special thank you to our favorite vet Alice, who has been absolutely incredible throughout this whole journey. She consistently goes above and beyond, not only medically but emotionally too. Her care, attention, reassurance and genuine love for animals is so evident in everything she does, and knowing Tonino was in her hands gave us enormous comfort during a very difficult time.

She treated Tonino with so much kindness and care from start to finish, and we will always be grateful for that.

We feel very lucky to have found a practice filled with people who are not only exceptionally professional and knowledgeable, but also deeply compassionate.

Thank you again from all of us - and especially from Tonino 🐾

Could not recommend this team more highly.

Great local vet in the Tooting area. Staff are very friendly, knowledgable and I was able to get a vet appointment same day for my two cats. I went for a regular check up and signed up for their monthly plan which is cost effective for what you get. Would recommend to others in the area!
Today we visit for the first time with puppy's, check up and injection + microchip.  Brilliant surgery.  Vets with passion for animals.  Highly recommended. Thank you so much for everything ❤️

I honestly could not recommend Tooting Vets enough. We brought my little dog Peppa in on Friday 24th April after noticing a lump on her side and just wanted to get it checked out. We saw Amelia who aspirated the lump and sent it off to the lab to determine what it was. She called us straight away on the Monday with the results and sadly it came back as a soft tissue sarcoma.

Amelia helped us schedule surgery and booked us in with Alice on Wednesday of the same week! Alice performed Peppa’s surgery and she is just brilliant. She managed to achieve excellent margins around the lump to make sure she had removed absolutely all of it. Nurse Marlie was with Peppa the whole day giving her so much love, cuddles and reassurance. She also monitored her anaesthetic which went perfectly.

We are just all so grateful to have such a great surgery caring for Peppa. You genuinely get to know the staff, which I love!

We have also just found out she has the all clear!!❤️ Genuinely cannot thank you enough for helping give her more years with us and for going above and beyond for her. Peppa is my whole world and I will always be so grateful for everything you guys have done for her.

Alice, Amelia, Marlie and Mark - you are all the best!

Ive been used Tooting Veterinary Surgery since I got my now 6 month puppy, Bonnie. Whenever I’ve had to visit the staff, reception and vet, have been very friendly and so helpful. They’ve offered great advice whether it’s random calls from me asking questions or popping in for appointments. Highly recommend!
Thank you to Mark, Luke, and Rami for their help with our little Oatmilk - We have a new pet, and a new vet!

Such a fantastic practice. They fitted me in at short notice and were very helpful. This isn't my usual Vet, I normally go to the DNA practice in Sutton, but I couldn't get an appointment today. But the great thing with DNA is that there are lots of practices and with a shared database, so you can usually get an appointment.Totally recommend Tooting Veterinary Practice. I would definitely use them again.

We're so glad Tooting Vets opened! Booking an appointment is straightforward, and they've always got availability when we need it.
From the receptionist to the vet, everyone's genuinely friendly and goes above and beyond. They listen properly, take their time explaining things, and you can tell they actually care.
What really stands out though is how they treat our dog as an individual. She gets greeted by name, given proper cuddles, and treated like a beloved patient—not just another appointment. It makes such a difference: she actually looks forward to visits, leaves with a full belly of treats, and you can see she's been cared for with real affection.
Genuinely can't recommend them highly enough.
Sat in the hallway but loved every second of it
Very friendly receptionist. That’s for start. Vet was super friendly too. Very clean clinic. My kitten felt very comfortable here. Highly recommend.
Friendly and professional,  would highly recommend it
Tooting vet > streatham vet

I was booked an emergency consultation at Tooting vets this morning after my cat Tino had a bad fall. It was my first time at this branch. Both the receptionist and Amelia, who did the consultation, were absolutely lovely. In addition to making sure Tino wasn't severely hurt from the accident, Amelia offered to clean the poop inside the carrier after my very nervous little guy had soiled himself on the way. The surgery itself had a welcoming and calming atmosphere and was very clean. Thank you very much for your professionalism, your kindness and your care. I really appreciated it.

Fantastic service
Supported us all the way with care and understanding at a very difficult time.
Arranged the cremation and return of our precious dog.
Couldn't ask for a better service thankyou
Great Surgery, amazing and loving team!

Since switching to this surgery 6 months ago I have nothing but good things to say about every interaction and visit I've had. I first went for a consultation for a second quote for a dental cleaning (under general anaesthetic), and the nurses and vets were so welcoming and patient with my nervous dog. When I asked about the price, they could just point to a poster on the wall which declares their prices for dental work openly, and it was less that half of what I was quoted at the previous practice (£350 vs £900+). I'm very happy to have made the switch.

Had my cat spayed at Tooting vets and I can tell they really love animals.
Everyone was really lovely.
Thanks to the vet Amelia for being kind and knowledgeable, Marlie for being lovely and Mark for being helpful and funny! ☺️
Friendly service, professional caind

Excellent vet group always professional and explain. Required a fairly urgent appointment Wimbledon could not do until Monday and I could not do Monday. They checked other branches and found space tooting. Again Excellent staff took time to explain.  Very pleased with service

My puppy Pedro went to the new Tooting Vet for a routine check-up and vaccination, then subsequently his booster. Everyone was genuinely friendly and efficient. Pedro had happy visits and there will be no problem with taking him there again.  I have recommended this vet practice to my nearby dog-lover friends… GOOD NEWS should be shared!👍

My nominated vet surgery , has taken care of all my cats for years, for neutering, microchips, health check ups, cuts or sickness that they have had. I used to go to the Mitcham branch, and I was thrilled when they opened one in Tooting, which is much closer to me. It made me happy because I can now easily pop over if I need flea or worming treatment for the cats. The staff is exceptionally polite. I recommend 100%
Brilliant new surgery, we follow vet Alice P around town to whichever site she is working, she is one of the best - Tooting are very lucky to have her. Highly recommend!
You’ll be pleased with the service.  I can’t fault it.  I left feeling heard and not diagnosed with money in mind.
Short waiting time for a visit, very nice and professional service, highly recommended

Had been to another vet before these guys and were really unhappy with them and felt they didn't listen or help our boy. Booked in to this place and it was so much better! The vet really took the time to listen our concerns and fully checked our dog thoroughly and found what could be a cause for him being unhappy and set out a plan going forward. The reception staff were also really kind and we just felt the overall service was kind, calm and informative. We will definitely continue to use these guys in the future and would recommend them to anyone looking for a vet! Thank you from us and Zero (aka Vero!) 😂
We've been really impressed with the service and the people so far - friendly, efficient and caring!

We can’t thank the team enough for the incredible care they’ve given our dog. We came here after they opened as we were at Streatham Hill before but this new location much more suitable for us.

From the moment we walk through the door, they are so attentive and gentle — especially important as our dog can be quite nervous. The staff always take the time to comfort him, go at his pace, and make the experience as stress-free as possible.

They’re also fantastic with us as owners — always happy to explain things clearly, answer questions thoroughly, and never make us feel rushed. You really feel like your pet is in caring, capable hands. We’re so grateful to have such a supportive and knowledgeable team - definitely recommended!

The best vets In town! My little chook FOMO had been attacked by a fox! She's now back in the game clucking away happily after the wonderful staff here took such good care of her! I can't thank you enough 🙏 …

A new practise that I was referred to after the Streatham Hill branch was fully booked. Mikey was kind and patient with my cat Lucy, and very clear with his diagnosis and instructions for me. The Reception was also great despite clearly being very busy. Slightly awkward for parking compared to Streatham Hill, but otherwise a fantastic service.
Alice P is the nicest and thorough vet you can have.. highly recommended

Fantastic service as always and this new clinic is equipped with new and modern equipment as well, very spacious, clean and of course great service from everyone. Thank you Mike for looking after Roxy and giving top care 😊 …
